milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate toward and visually observe the mossy stone brick structure. The structure center is at approximately (9, 2, 9) spawn-relative (walls span from (5,0,5) to (12,5,12)). max_distance=12 ensures the player has moved toward the structure from spawn, and facing_tolerance=60 confirms they are looking at it.

Uses inventory_has because mining a cartography table always drops itself as an item into the player's inventory. No tool is required to mine it. The cartography table is placed at (~9, ~1, ~8) inside the structure. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks since the mined drop ends up in inventory.

Uses inventory_has because mining black terracotta with a pickaxe drops the block as an item into the player's inventory. The player is given a wooden pickaxe via /give command (required for terracotta to drop). Three black terracotta blocks are placed in the back corner at (~10,~1,~10), (~11,~1,~10), (~10,~1,~11). Player needs to mine at least 1.
